description:
Port-map §4. The hard one. Shell command execution with:

- Streaming stdout/stderr back via on_update as chunks arrive
- Working dir = session cwd (optional override via args)
- Env merge with session env
- Timeout (default 120s, configurable per-call)
- Hard kill on abort: SIGTERM the process group (pgid) first,
  SIGKILL after grace window. Must terminate child processes
  recursively (`bash -c 'sleep 100 & wait'` should fully die).

Implementation: depend on `:erlexec` — it supports setpgid and
signal propagation to the group. Add via mix.exs.

Module: OctoPi.Coder.Tools.Bash (implements Tool.Handler).
Emits telemetry [:octo_pi_coder, :bash, :start/:stop/:timeout].

Output truncation: match upstream rules (max 100 lines or 32 KB
of stdout, tail rest with a "...truncated N lines" marker).

TDD:
- Simple `echo hi` → stdout captured.
- Streaming: `for i in 1 2 3; do echo $i; sleep 0.05; done` — on_update
  fires at least twice with partial output.
- Timeout: `sleep 10` with timeout 200ms → error result.
- Abort propagation: start `sleep 60`, abort session, verify `ps`
  shows no orphan (integration test, @tag :integration).
- pgid kill: `bash -c 'sleep 60 & sleep 60 & wait'` — abort kills
  all three processes.

Depends on .1.
title: Bash tool: erlexec streaming + pgid termination on abort
